validation.local: cargo build, cargo test, cargo clippy -- -D warnings and npm run build passed for both apps; 146 Synapt tests, 136 SynaptClip tests, and 15 release-coordination tests per app passed. Core all-feature tests and clippy passed.
validation.sqlite: Runtime version regression tests require SQLite >=3.54.0 and passed.
validation.source_maps: No .map files in either production dist tree. Input maps can still be processed by build tools.
validation.platforms: Local Rust checks ran on macOS. Linux CI and a new Windows updater compilation check run on the PRs; the local tests do not assert those results.

compatibility_notes: Updater 2.14.1 requires Tauri >=2.12 and uses ZIP 9. Windows Extract error variant wraps ZIP 9 errors; app does not match that variant. Signed update verification is retained.
SQLx 0.7 to 0.8 SQLite decode/macro changes reviewed; migrations and app database tests pass. Unused Any/JSON defaults disabled; SQLite, runtime, migrations and macros retained.
SQLx-sqlite 0.8.6 is vendored unchanged except the libsqlite3-sys requirement moves from 0.30.1 to 0.39.1. Even upstream SQLx 0.9.0 caps this below 0.38. Licenses and provenance are included.
Direct LRU cache migrated to the patched 0.18 series; used constructor/get/put/clear APIs remain compatible. Tantivy still requires a separate old LRU, documented below.

React Router 7.18.5 retains the HashRouter, Routes, Route and useNavigate APIs used here. App has fixed routes, no splats/loaders/actions/SSR hydration; Node 20 and React 19 satisfy its requirements. Frontend build passes.
release_order: Core PR #6 merged after green checks; stable v0.2.3 published with core.json.
Review and merge app PRs only after checks and user approval. Either app may release first.
App release jobs read exact core 0.2.3 from Cargo.lock, wait for the stable tag/asset, then check out that tag. Runtime core checks remain informational and cannot block signed app updates.
notes: Dependabot disabled for synapt-core; local Cargo audit used. Reachability assessments are source/feature based; no exploit demonstration is claimed. No critical/high Cargo vulnerabilities remain. Optional MySQL RSA advisory and inherited unsoundness/maintenance warnings remain explicitly deferred.
